payload.text: WHERE THE DAY'S WORKING ARTEFACTS ARE, because a compact takes them out of context and not off disk. THE SWEEP PROCEDURE, agreed with devbin-vc and not to be improvised: devbin-vc says ready, vc re-confirms the tree is clean AT THAT MOMENT, devbin-vc commits the sweep pathspec under its directive 10, vc verifies the manifest reads 0.1.6, bin/devbin doctor, bin/devbin release check past step 1 and bin/devbin check all, and only then hv pushes -- once, carrying every commit.
